name: Ultra Ring
descriptionTemplate: At the start of exploration, increase the Relic Capacity by +1, and {Ultra} Awakener gains its "Dimensional Image". For each {Ultra} Awakener in the team, increase the Relic Capacity by +1.
lore: Endless dimensions overlapped, at this moment "I" am infinitely complete.
